case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We appreciate your proposal of €5.74 per unit, payment 30 days net, and a 12-month contract, as well as the service your team provides. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. Our forecast fc:360011@2026-09 expects 208,400 units a year, a change of +15.3 %. The forecasted volume, together with a longer commitment from us, would give you greater planning security. On that basis, we propose EUR 4.82 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract. We would welcome your thoughts on this package and look forward to continuing our cooperation.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We truly value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. 

Our offer is a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Please note that a longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in. Furthermore, the contract term is reflected in the price. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days. We are always here to support your supply needs with our extensive range and reliable service, and we look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for reviewing the volume change data and for moving towards us. We appreciate your revised offer of €5.51 per unit with 90 days net and a 36-month contract. We understand that you have factored the cost of the payment term and the contract length into your price, and we value your continued support for our supply needs.

Your rolling twelve-month on-time delivery in 2026Q3 was 88.6 % (sc:70610@2026Q3). Taking that performance and the volume change into account, our revised proposal is EUR 4.97 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract. Could you meet us on these terms? We would welcome your thoughts and look forward to continuing our cooperation.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your reply and for moving towards us. We appreciate your confirmation that the delivery record data holds, and we understand that you have factored the payment term and contract term into your calculation. We also value your reliable service and wide product range.

In response to your offer of €5.42 per unit, we can improve our proposal to EUR 5.10 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract. We believe these terms provide a sound basis for bringing the fastener kit together with one distributor. Could you meet us there? We look forward to your thoughts.

Best regards
